snippet.title: Roommates, Romance, and Ringing Hearts | Coming Soon on Steam!
snippet.description:
Live together. Fall in love. Make your choice.
In Roommates, Romance, and Ringing Hearts, you'll share a home with five charming heroines in a live-action romance adventure. Every decision you make shapes your story—and your ending.

🎮 A choice-driven love story
💞 Five heroines, multiple endings

👉 Wishlist now on Steam and follow for more updates!
